answer: New identities post a 20,000 POA bond stamped as a copper token in the arrival registry. Fake clusters emit a detectable ripple of correlated join times; a flagged ripple triggers a sweep: 100% slashed, 50% burned and 50% paid to the reporter, plus a 10-epoch identity ban. An attacker fielding 1,000 fakes must lock or burn 20,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 20,000 POA once, refunded at settlement; each slashed bond remains a relic marking that fingerprint. Limitation: pricing is capital-biased, so a funded attacker absorbs 20M easily while newcomers face the same cold-start cost.
